---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a command, hook, or catalog entry for base_project
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What's missing

A clear description of the gap — what you're trying to do that base_project doesn't
currently help with.

## Proposed approach

How you'd expect this to work — a new command, a new `plugins.json` catalog entry, a change
to an existing command, etc.

## Why this fits base_project specifically

base_project is deliberately narrow in scope — see `dev/ROADMAP.md`'s "Descartado" section for
real features that were considered and rejected, with reasons. Before proposing something new,
it's worth checking whether it's already been decided against, and if so, what would be
different this time. If it's genuinely new ground, say why it belongs in base_project itself
rather than as a standalone plugin recommended via `source/plugins.json`.

## Alternatives considered

Anything else you tried, or existing base_project commands that partially cover this.
